title: fix: validate search query parameter minimum length
head: xiaofengzii:fix/search-validation-5756
body:
## Summary
This PR adds validation to enforce a minimum length for search queries.

## Changes
- Reject empty or single-character queries with 400 and a clear error message
- Require at least 2 characters for any search query
- Add tests for valid query, empty query, single character, and two character queries

## Testing
- All tests pass: `node --test src/tests/search.test.js`

/claim #743
Closes #5756
